question: Is customer data encrypted at rest in every production data store?
Is multi-factor authentication enforced for all workforce access to production systems?
Do you have a documented recovery time objective (RTO) of 8 hours or less for the production service?
Are background checks performed on personnel before they are given access to customer data?
Has an independent third party performed a penetration test of the production application within the last 12 months?
Are user access reviews for production systems performed and completed at least quarterly?
Do any sub-processors store or process customer data on your behalf?
Is customer data stored and processed exclusively within the European Union?
Are all code changes peer-reviewed and approved before they are deployed to production?
Are production backups taken daily and restore-tested at least annually?
Do you maintain a documented incident response plan that commits to notifying affected customers within 72 hours?
Do all workforce members complete security awareness training at least annually?
